title: Gram Sabha Meeting – 2 October 2026
description: All registered voters and residents of Lakhlgoan are hereby informed that the Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti Special Gram Sabha will be convened on 2 October 2026 at 11:00 AM at the Gram Panchayat Karyalaya courtyard. Key agenda items include GPDP mid-year review, social audit of water works, and PMAY-G beneficiary verification.

title: Property Tax Payment Reminder
description: Households across Wards 1 to 6 are requested to clear their first-half House Tax (Ghar Patti) and Water Cess (Pani Patti) dues for Financial Year 2026–27 before 15 October 2026 at the Panchayat office counter to avail the 5% early-payment rebate.

title: Water Supply Maintenance Notice
description: Due to scheduled cleaning and chlorination of the main Overhead ESR Tank near Ward 3, morning tap water supply will remain suspended on Tuesday, 29 September 2026 between 8:00 AM and 2:00 PM. Citizens are requested to store adequate drinking water in advance.

title: Swachh Bharat Village Cleanliness Drive
description: Under the 'Swachhata Hi Seva' fortnight campaign, a voluntary Shramdaan and plastic-free village drive will be conducted on Sunday at 7:30 AM starting from the Zilla Parishad Primary School ground. All youth mandals, SHG members, and villagers are invited to participate.

title: PMAY-G Beneficiary Verification Camp
description: A special document verification camp for Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana (Gramin) applicants is scheduled at the Gram Panchayat Hall. Listed applicants must bring original Aadhaar Card, 7/12 or 8A extract, and bank passbook copy.

title: Quotation Notice for Solar High-Mast Lamp at Bazaar Peth
description: Sealed item-rate quotations are invited from registered electrical contractors for supply, erection, and commissioning of 12-meter Solar High-Mast LED Lighting system at Lakhlgoan main chowk.

title: Monsoon Vector-Borne Disease Prevention & Fogging Schedule
description: Primary Health Sub-Centre Lakhlgoan and Gram Panchayat sanitation staff will carry out evening anti-larval spraying and fogging across all six wards this week. Keep water containers covered.

title: Emergency Advisory: Desilting of Nalla Culvert Near Ward 6
description: Heavy machinery work is underway at the Ward 6 agricultural approach culvert. Heavy tractor-trolleys are advised to use the alternate Hanuman Mandir bypass road for 3 days.

title: Independence Day Flag Hoisting & Gram Sabha Notice
description: Official invitation and schedule for 79th Independence Day flag hoisting ceremony at 8:00 AM followed by statutory Gram Sabha meeting.

title: Draft Notice: Winter Rabi Crop Water Rotation Schedule
description: Proposed schedule for community well and percolation tank maintenance ahead of the upcoming Rabi agricultural season.
